note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help) and their sub-items
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard application controls (New, Open, Save, Print, Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, formatting options, etc.)
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application status indicators (Ready, cell reference, zoom level, etc.)
Spreadsheet sheet tab list -- renders operator-defined sheet names (typically Sheet1, Sheet2, etc.) which are part of the application's default document structure
